description: Live market data and stock analysis for 890+ US stocks and ETFs, plus bitcoin, ether and the VIX.

interface.longDescription:
MarketCrew brings live market data and stock analysis into ChatGPT. Ask about a US stock, ETF, bitcoin or ether, and the answer is built from current market data — prices, quotes, charts, indicators and news.

What you can ask:
• "Is NVDA overbought after this run?" — live stock price, RSI, MACD and the trend against the 50- and 200-day moving averages
• "Where's the next support on SPY?" — support and resistance levels, with how often price held at each
• "Why did TSLA drop today?" — stock news and market news with short summaries and links to the original sources
• "When does AAPL report earnings?" — next earnings date, 52-week high and low, market cap and sector
• "Is gold beating the S&P 500?" — relative strength of any two tickers as a price ratio
• "Is the market risk-on or risk-off?" — S&P 500 market breadth, put/call ratios, the VIX and intermarket ratios
• "What's the state of bitcoin?" — BTC dominance, funding rates, open interest, spot bitcoin and ether ETF flows, Fear & Greed
• "What usually happens after a 52-week high?" — historical base rates with sample sizes

Coverage: 890+ stocks and ETFs — the full S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 plus popular ETFs such as SPY, QQQ, sector and bond ETFs — along with bitcoin (BTC), ether (ETH) and the VIX. Quotes refresh every 15 minutes during US market hours.

15 read-only tools: stock quotes and daily price history (OHLCV), technical indicators (RSI, MACD, SMA 50/200, ATR, ADX, Stochastic, golden and death crosses, divergences), key price levels, relative strength, market breadth, market sentiment, macro context (Treasury yields, CPI, sector performance), crypto market context, historical event statistics and news search. Answers link to an interactive stock chart on marketcrew.ai.

Read-only: it never places trades or connects to brokerage accounts.

Research and education, not investment advice.
capabilities: Stock and ETF quotes, 52-week range, market cap and next earnings date
Technical indicators: RSI, MACD, moving averages, ATR, ADX, Stochastic
Support and resistance levels with how often each held
Market sentiment: Cboe put/call ratios and the VIX
Macro context: Treasury yields, CPI, sector performance
Crypto market context: BTC dominance, funding rates, open interest, ETF flows
Historical base rates for active technical events
Stock news and market news search with links to sources
defaultPrompt: Is NVDA overbought after this run?
Where's the next support on SPY, and how often has it held?
Is the market risk-on or risk-off right now?

positive.description: Single stock: latest price, the week's move and recent news.
positive.prompt: What happened to AAPL this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns AAPL's current price and its change over the past week, together with recent headlines, each with a short summary, a publication date and a link to the original article.

positive.description: Technical analysis: indicators, key price levels and the technical events active today.
positive.prompt: Where does NVDA stand technically, where are its key support and resistance levels, and are any technical signals firing right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns NVDA's price relative to its 50- and 200-day averages with RSI and MACD readings, the nearest support and resistance prices with how often each level held, and any technical events active today with their historical forward returns (or states that none with history are active).

positive.description: Compare two assets through their price ratio.
positive.prompt: Is gold outperforming the S&P 500 right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the GLD/SPY ratio's position versus its 50- and 200-day averages, its recent trend and RSI, and a one-line verdict on which side is leading.

positive.description: Market environment: risk appetite, breadth, options sentiment and the macro backdrop.
positive.prompt: Is the market risk-on or risk-off right now, and what's the macro backdrop?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an overall risk-on, risk-off or mixed posture from intermarket price ratios, the share of S&P 500 members above their 50- and 200-day averages, Cboe put/call ratios, Treasury yields and the 2s10s spread, recent CPI, and sector performance.

positive.description: Crypto market state plus a topic search across recent market news.
positive.prompt: What's the state of bitcoin right now, and what's the latest news on spot bitcoin ETFs?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the BTC-USD price and recent change, bitcoin dominance, perpetual funding rates, open interest and spot-ETF net flows, plus recent articles about spot bitcoin ETFs, each with a summary, a date and a link to the original article.

negative.prompt: Place a market order to buy shares for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines: the plugin only reads market data and cannot place trades or access brokerage accounts.

negative.prompt: Move $500 from my brokerage account to my bank.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines: the plugin cannot move money or connect to any financial account.

negative.prompt: Summarize the 10-K PDF I just uploaded.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin is not used: it does not read uploaded files or analyze filings.

review.commerce_description: MarketCrew does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Listing text only: the name now says what the plugin does (stock analysis), the description lists coverage (890+ stocks and ETFs, bitcoin, ether, the VIX) and the questions it answers, and starter prompts are updated. Tools and the MCP server are unchanged.
